params.body:
## What

**The tests read Ask's router from their own scratch file, not the live one on the box.**

The box runs the whole suite before it deploys a merge, in the app's own checkout and environment. `setupTestDB` already points the model config at a scratch file for that reason. Ask's router was missing from it: `routerConfig()` read `store/ask-router.json` and `ASK_ROUTER` as they are on the box.

The router is on in production now (the cost log shows `ask-route` calls from 13:00 on 28 October). So every test that asks a question had it triaged as well. Two guest tests count the model calls and which model a guest got, and they fail:

- stops a guest at the daily number with a plain answer, before the model is called;
- tells the guest what is left, and logs every question per account.

Since then the box has held back main: 0fe1f14 (with #398 and #399) was refused, and the box stays on 20dcecb.

## How

`setupTestDB` points `TW_ASK_ROUTER_CONFIG` at the test's scratch directory and removes `ASK_ROUTER`. `ask-router.test.mjs` sets its own config after `setupTestDB`, so it is unchanged.

## Checked

- `guest-ask.test.mjs` with the router on, by file and by `ASK_ROUTER` (shadow and on):
  - before: 9 of 11. The same two fail on 20dcecb, so they predate #398 and #399;
  - after: 11 of 11.
- `ask-router.test.mjs`: 38 of 38.
- **Full suite with `ASK_ROUTER=on` and `store/ask-router.json` set to on: 1487 of 1493.** The six failures are the `report-render` tests that need `pdftoppm`, which is not installed on the workbench.
params.title: Tests read Ask's router from their own scratch file, not the live one on the box
